slides.heading: 1 — This isn't hype anymore
body: As of early 2026, 38% of seven-figure businesses are run by a single person — up from a rounding error a few years ago.
41.8 million solopreneurs now add $1.3 trillion to the economy. AI is the reason.

slides.heading: 2 — Let AI build the product
body: Base44 hit 250k users and sold to Wix for $80M — built lean, fast, with AI doing the heavy lifting.
Tools like Cursor, Lovable and Replit turn a plain-English spec into a working app. No engineering team.

slides.heading: 3 — Make AI the rest of the company
body: Support, docs, design, and ops that used to need five hires now run on AI workflows.
HeadshotPro does $3.6M a year as a one-person shop. The 'team' is a stack of tools.

slides.heading: 4 — Pick a narrow, boring niche
body: The winners aren't building the next ChatGPT. They solve one painful task for one specific group.
Micro-SaaS in unsexy niches is clearing $10k–$50k/month with teams of one to three.

slides.heading: 5 — Stay lean on purpose
body: Use AI to reach product-market fit and real revenue at near-zero headcount.
Then make surgical hires only where human judgment beats automation — not a day before.
